'''Heirad''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Dread Host]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He, [[Ciphas]], and [[Kel'sara]] were part of the forces that accompanied [[Kephess]] to [[Asation]], and the trio fell in battle while guarding the path to the [[Grand Hypergate]] through the [[Quadrilateral Forum]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Heirad, along with Ciphas and Kel'sara, appear collectively as the second boss in "Terror From Beyond," an Operation added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.4.<ref name="TOR" /> While not visible in game, Heirad's character model uses Rattataki textures underneath his helmet.<ref name="Jedipedia" />
